title: OSLS layout (.osls)
description: Orbit Speaker Layout System — a single loudspeaker layout. See docs/SPEC.md. Structural validation only; the SDK additionally enforces semantic rules (Cartesian/polar consistency when both are given, ordering completeness, identity sanity, LFE rules).

vendor.description: Reverse-DNS namespace for custom layouts (e.g. io.orbitspatial).

frame.description: The layout's reference frame: egocentric (listener-relative — speakers on a sphere at BS.2051 angles) or allocentric (room-anchored — positions in a normalized cube). Independent of whether positions are stored as Cartesian x/y/z or polar az/el; advisory, sets a visual editor's default view.

orderings.description: spec name -> channel order. Each value is a permutation of the speaker ids.

oneOf.description: speaker id with a spec-specific label override

arrays.description: Optional speaker groupings (SPEC §2.4): speakers that together stand in for one position, e.g. a cinema side-surround array.

id.description: Layout-local stable key for the array.

sp.description: ITU-R BS.2051 SP-label of the position the array stands in for (e.g. M+135).

id.description: Layout-local stable key referenced by orderings.

sp.description: ITU-R BS.2051 SP-label, the cross-vendor identity (e.g. M+090, U+045, T+000, LFE1).

speaker.comment: A speaker MUST carry at least one complete position: Cartesian (x,y,z) and/or polar (az,el[,dist]). Both is allowed. JSON Schema enforces 'at least one complete set'; the SDK validator additionally enforces that, when both are given, they resolve to the same point within tolerance.
